common_action_add: Button that adds an item to a list.
common_action_back: Button that goes to the previous step or screen.
common_action_cancel: Button that dismisses a dialog or form without applying it.
common_action_close: Button or menu item that closes a dialog, panel or window.
common_action_continue: Button that goes on to the next step of a flow.
common_action_copy: Button or menu item that copies the selection or value to the clipboard.
common_action_delete: Button or menu item that deletes the selected item. Destructive: dialogs that confirm it say what is deleted.
common_action_done: Button that finishes a flow or closes a confirmation once the work is complete.
common_action_edit: Button or menu item that makes an item editable.
common_action_open: Button or menu item that opens an item (a file, a project, a link).
common_action_remove: Button or menu item that removes an item from a list without deleting its data.
common_action_rename: Button or menu item that changes the name of an item.
common_action_retry: Button offered after a failure that runs the same action again.
common_action_save: Button that saves the current form, file or settings.
common_action_search: Label of a search field or button that runs a search.
common_action_undo: Button or menu item that reverts the last change.
common_state_empty: Text of an empty list or panel that has no items yet.
common_state_loading: Status shown while content is loading. The ellipsis means the wait is not over.
common_state_saving: Status shown while a change is being saved.
